mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the tight labor market supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a strong economy without inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% and CPIAUCSL falls by more than 0.2% in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 500,000), a high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1,100) signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 500000 and HOUST > 1100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
